title: [Bug] Voice mode transcription not appearing in input after processing
body:
**Bug Description**
"Voice mode shows listening/processing but transcription never appears in input. Tested in Ghostty and Terminal.app.
  v2.1.83, macOS."

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.83
- Feedback ID: df9c035d-d180-486c-ac75-b5b08e603919
